name: XlCellInsertionMode
description: Specifies the way that rows on the specified worksheet are added or deleted to accommodate the number of rows in a recordset returned by a query.

constants.name: xlOverwriteCells
constants.description: No new cells or rows are added to the worksheet. Data in surrounding cells is overwritten to accommodate any overflow.

constants.name: xlInsertDeleteCells
constants.description: Partial rows are inserted or deleted to match the exact number of rows required for the new recordset.

constants.name: xlInsertEntireRows
constants.description: Entire rows are inserted, if necessary, to accommodate any overflow. No cells or rows are deleted from the worksheet.
